Sabang Beach Baler
Birthplace of Philippine Surfing
What it is & Why go
Sabang Beach is synonymous with the origins of surfing in the
Philippines. Characterized by its broad, gray-sand shoreline and
consistent waves coming from the Pacific Ocean, it offers an accessible
and energetic atmosphere perfect for surf enthusiasts and beachgoers
alike.
Highlights
Oct–March Swells: The prime season for reliable, larger waves suited
for serious surfers.
Surf Schools: Dozens of surf instructors and board rentals line the
beachfront, making it incredibly accessible to start learning.
Walkable Coastline: A long, flat shoreline ideal for leisurely strolls,
vibrant photography, and stunning sunrise/sunset views.
Practical Notes
Best for beginners to intermediate surfers. The waves are more forgiving in the
summer months. It is highly recommended to go early in the morning to beat
the crowds and catch the calmest winds.

DRAMATIC COASTLINE
Dicasalarin Cove &
Baler Lighthouse
A breathtaking blend of rugged cliffs, serene
waters, and a historic vantage point. Discover why
this secluded paradise is a must-visit.
Highlights
Stunning cliffside viewpoints
Photogenic coastline drive
Best experienced in clear weather
PRACTICAL NOTES
Timing:Go mid-morning for optimal lighting.
Preparation:Bring sun protection and plenty of
water.
Logistics:Plan travel time accordingly as roads
can be steep.

Ditumabo Mother Falls
The Iconic Waterfall Trek in San Luis
�140 ft
WATERFALL DROP
30�45 min
TREK (ONE WAY)
Highlights
Exciting river crossings and scenic bamboo bridges
Misty, refreshing swim spot right at the base of the falls
Practical Notes
Wear sturdy, grippy footwear for navigating wet and slippery rocks
Prepare for a moderately challenging but highly rewarding hike

Dingalan Viewpoint Batanes of
the East)
Batanes of the East
What it is & Why go
Often referred to as the "Batanes of the East," the Dingalan Viewpoint
features rolling green hills that abruptly meet the crashing waves of the
Pacific Ocean. It offers a breathtaking, windswept vista that provides a
majestic coastal encounter unlike any other in the region.
Highlights
Ridge-and-Ocean Panorama: Sweeping, dramatic views of the
coastline from the crest of the rolling hills.
Photo Spots Along Trail: Numerous picturesque vantage points along
the hike perfect for capturing the landscape.
Contrast to Baler Surf Town: A serene, elevated escape that serves as
a beautiful contrast to the bustling surf culture nearby.
Practical Notes
Start your hike early to beat the midday sun and avoid the crowds. Remember
to pack plenty of water to stay hydrated and a light layer to protect against the
strong coastal winds at the peak.

SUNRISE ON THE ANIAO ISLETS
Diguisit Beach & Rock
Formations
Experience the raw beauty of Aurora's coastline
where dramatic rock formations rise from the
crashing waves. A perfect destination for early
risers seeking a spectacular morning view.
Highlights
Rock formations & islet silhouettes
Golden hour photography
Coastal breeze and wave soundscape
PRACTICAL NOTES
Timing:Best visited at sunrise for optimal views.
Safety:Watch your footing near wet, slippery
rocks.

Ermita Hill View Deck
360° Baler Bay Perspective

Early / Late

Orientation stop for North Coast drive
Windy open vantage
Practical Notes
Visit early morning or late afternoon for the best experience
Bring a hat to protect yourself from the sun at the open vantage

Heritage Walk: Baler Church + Museo de Baler
Explore the iconic Baler Church and discover local artifacts at
Museo de Baler.
What it is & Why go
Immerse yourself in the rich history and culture of Aurora by walking
through its most significant historical sites. It's the perfect way to
understand the heritage that shaped the region.
Key Highlights
Baler Church: A historic landmark known worldwide for the Siege of
Baler.
Museo de Baler: Houses fascinating exhibits and well-preserved
historical artifacts.
Plaza Walk: Best paired with a leisurely town plaza stroll and tasting
local snacks.
Practical Notes
•Dress respectfully when visiting the church (avoid revealing clothing).
•Go earlier in the day for a quieter and more intimate museum experience.
